posts.title: Semantica11y - Semantic HTML for Everyone
posts.description: Modern web development has habit of using <div> , <span> and other non-native elements and then slapping a coat of ARIA roles on them to ensure they are "accessible'. The result is a tangled web of ARIA that is used to cover a foundation of "DIV soup". I built Semantica11y to help fix that. posts.title: Accessibility Snapshot Testing in iOS
posts.description: Snapshot testing is a popular type of regression testing that a lot of development teams are unaware has untapped potential when it comes to accessibility. The AccessibilitySnapshot library offers a way to bring accessibility into your automated regression suite.
